items.summary: Passé récent: conjugate with venir de, circle forms, combine with présent progressif.
Unit 25 Bilan: match time expressions, dans/depuis/en/il y a/pendant, présent progressif.
Unit 25 Bilan continued: rewrite six sentences in the passé récent.
Imperative opener: first-group verbs; transform tu-sentences and pluralise imperatives.
Imperative hyphen and -s before en/y; conjugate verbs and aller in imperative.
Imperative of 2nd/3rd group verbs: endings, circle correct form, word order.
Imperative conjugation; avoir/être/savoir/vouloir exceptions: pluralise and reformulate.
Imperative tu forms, verb box completion, listening affirmative versus negative imperative.
Negative imperative: transform sentences, add ne/n', conjugate negative forms.
Unit 26 Bilan: hear imperative or present, give directions, match advice.
Unit 26 Bilan continued: conjugate six verbs in the imperative, some negative.
Futur proche opener: match subjects, hear futur proche or present, word order.
Conjugate in futur proche, rewrite in negative, order words into negative sentences.
Negative futur proche: say the contrary, conjugate ne pas + infinitive.
Unit 27 Bilan: circle futur proche verbs, conjugate parler, pluralise sentences.
